articles.title: How to make an e-invoice and print the IRN and QR
articles.summary: Make the e-invoice JSON for one invoice in Nivesh Sahayak, upload it on the IRP with your login, load the reply and print the IRN, Ack No. and signed QR.

articles.title: Many e-invoices at once from Excel
articles.summary: Fill the Nivesh Sahayak Excel template with many invoices, check them, download one e-invoice file for bulk upload, and load the reply for all at once.
